notes:
- Your page: all your chats. Sign in with your phone number (a 6-digit code by text) and see your whole chat with the assistant, day by day, with 'Show earlier messages' back to the first one. Chat from there too. Works on a phone and on a computer.
- Connected accounts. On the same page: Connect Google (Gmail, Calendar and Drive, read only). Then ask 'what's on my calendar tomorrow?' or 'any new email from the school?'. The assistant only reads; it never sends, changes or deletes. Each person connects only their own account. The admin turns this on once in Settings → Connect accounts (Google) with a free Google Client ID and secret; the steps are on that card. Other kinds of accounts can be added the same way later.
- Admin: the same page + 'Manage system'. The admin signs in with his phone number like everyone, sees his own chats and accounts, and Manage system opens the dashboard and settings. From the dashboard, My chats goes the other way.
- Access until a date. People → Details → Access: 1 month (again = one more month), until a date, or No end date. The list shows 'until Dec 12' / 'ended'. After the end date the assistant sends ONE polite text ('Your access to … has ended. Please contact the admin…', editable in Settings) and then stops answering, reminders included. Extending or clearing the date turns it back on.
- Faster replies, fewer AI calls. Plain chat ('hi', 'thanks', 'good night') is answered with ONE AI call (if the AI says it needs a tool after all, it gets them: one more call; a 'yes' to a question of the assistant always goes the full way). Questions that need the web get at most 3 rounds of searching (Settings → Tool rounds), then the answer; before, up to 12 calls for one message (that used up a free Gemini key's daily limit in 2 answers). A key at its per-minute limit is tried again after the time the provider says (or 20 s, was 60 s); a provider error rests a key 15 s (was 60 s). The key order and the 'no AI key could answer' report are unchanged.
- Speed card (Settings): AI calls per reply, thinking time, waiting time and texting time of the last replies. Each reply also writes one line to the log with where its time went.
- Old chats are not answered after a restart. A chat whose last message is from before the start (an old unread spam from Oct 29 was answered after a restart on Nov 12) is left alone; a new text in it later is answered as usual.
- Sending: shorter pause between the parts of a long reply (250 ms, was 700 ms) and a faster look for the sent bubble.
- New look, on phone and desktop (the redesign): New look, on phone and desktop. The whole web side is redesigned in the colours of the logo: the admin sign-in, the dashboard (Home, People, Connect, Sites, AI keys, Settings) and the person's own web chat at `/me`. Phone: a clean sign-in card under the logo, big buttons and fields (no zooming in, no sideways scrolling from 360 px up), a bottom bar with clear icons. Desktop: sign-in with the logo on the left and the form on the right; the dashboard has its menu on the left and lays its cards out in two columns, with a sensible width. Sign-in for people: the web chat's sign-in now says 'We text a 6-digit code to your phone'. When the web chat is on, the admin sign-in page shows a link for people who came to chat: 'Using the assistant? Open your chat →'.
- The person's page on a computer: your name and the menu on the left, the chat in a wide, readable column (not a stretched phone screen).
